full_description: Designation: Data Architect – Microsoft Fabric (US Healthcare) Experience: 8 to 10 Years Location: Bangalore Budget: 38 LPA Role Overview We are seeking an experienced Data Architect/Engineer to help lead the design, implementation, and maintenance of cloud data platforms for US healthcare clients. You will own the architecture from ingestion through the Gold layer, feeding Power BI semantic models and making the data ready for Power BI Dashboards, Data Agents and AI-driven workflows. You will work closely with our existing solution leaders and architects to oversee and guide our data engineers, BI developers, analysts and business stakeholders, and will communicate technical trade-offs clearly. This is a team lead role that requires demonstrable experience of leading/managing technical teams of varying levels of experience. Key Responsibilities Architecture and Data Modelling • Design data models including star/constellation/ snowflake schemas, and choose the right approach for each subject area based on performance, maintainability and reporting needs. • Design scalable, medallion-layered (Bronze / Silver / Gold) platforms on Microsoft Fabric using OneLake, Lakehouse and Warehouse. • Translate business requirements into robust, well-documented data models, conformed dimensions and fact grains. Data Engineering and Transformation • Review and guide ingestion and transformation built with Fabric Pipelines / Azure Data Factory, T-SQL and PySpark notebooks. • Implement transformation logic to meet business objectives and regulatory requirements, with schema mapping, reconciliation and data validation to preserve data integrity and security. • Write and review production-grade SQL for incremental loads, slowly changing dimensions (Type 1 / Type 2), data quality checks and source-to-target reconciliation, and set SQL coding standards and code-review practices for the team. • Design Power BI semantic models (DAX, RLS, certified datasets) that serve dashboards and Fabric Data Agents, using Direct Lake / Import / Direct Query over Gold-layer Delta tables where appropriate. Performance, Compliance and Documentation • Analyze performance and optimize across SQL, Spark and Fabric capacity (indexing, partitioning, Delta table design, capacity cost). • Enforce HIPAA / HITECH controls: PHI minimization, row-level security, auditing and de-identification patterns, aligned with SOC 2 and ISO 27001 practices. • Maintain documentation of architecture, lineage, data models and data dictionaries. Required Skills and Qualifications • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology or a related field (Master's preferred). • 8+ years in data architecture / database design, with 2+ years on a modern cloud data platform (Microsoft Fabric, Synapse or Databricks). • Expert-level SQL / T-SQL (complex query design, query optimization, stored procedures) plus advanced knowledge of Python / PySpark. • Deep command of advanced SQL constructs: window functions, CTEs (including recursive), PIVOT / UNPIVOT, MERGE, set-based logic and dynamic SQL, applied to large, complex healthcare datasets such as claims, encounters and eligibility. • Proven SQL performance tuning: reading and optimizing execution plans, indexing strategy (clustered, non-clustered, columnstore), statistics, partitioning, and diagnosing blocking, deadlocks and long running queries. • Hands-on SQL across the Microsoft stack, including Fabric Warehouse, the Lakehouse SQL analytics endpoint and Spark SQL, with a clear understanding of T-SQL surface-area differences between platforms. • Strong dimensional modelling expertise: Kimball methodology, star and snowflake schemas, slowly changing dimensions, and ELT design on Azure. • Experience with Azure SQL Database, SQL Server and Azure Data Factory, and with data migration methodologies. • Strong Power BI semantic modelling skills (DAX, RLS, Direct Lake, performance tuning). • Experience with Git. • US healthcare data experience under HIPAA, on either the hospital side or the payer side. • Excellent analytical, problem-solving, written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex concepts to non-technical stakeholders. • Strong leadership and team-player attitude. Good to Have • Hands-on exposure to Data Agents (Fabric Data Agents, Copilot or similar NL-to-SQL tools) and AI integration (Azure OpenAI, Claude, MCP or agent-based workflows). • Data governance tooling such as Microsoft Purview. • Power Automate / Power Apps and React front-end exposure. • HL7 / FHIR experience. • Master's degree in a relevant field. Additional Skills • Passion for the business of hospital transformation. • Excellent written and verbal communication. • Good team player

title: Principal Engineer (Warehouse Engineering)
full_description: ABOUT QUINCE Quince is a destination for builders, creators, innovators, and operators who want to come together and challenge the status quo. Our mission is simple: make really high quality essentials for really low prices, fairly and sustainably. We deliver on that mission through a unique manufacturer-to-consumer (M2C) model eliminating the layers of traditional retail that add cost and result in consumers paying more than they need to. We find, build relationships with, and work directly with the manufacturing partners behind some of the world’s finest products. From there, our teams design smart, efficient operational processes and build and deploy proprietary technology, AI, and analytics to help us scale fast. What began with a small assortment of elevated basics has quickly grown into a cross-category brand spanning apparel, accessories, home goods, and more. Today, tens of millions of people across a growing number of countries come – and return – to Quince because they trust us to deliver. OUR CULTURE Quince is a culture built for builders by builders. Our way of working starts with a blank sheet of paper. We question conventional thinking, use technology and data to uncover new opportunities, and move quickly to turn ideas into reality. We aren’t interested in replicating how others do retail. We’re building a better way – at a speed and scale unlike anything that’s been done before. We dream big and chase the hard problems others shy away from. Rejecting long-held assumptions is part of our company's DNA. Where conventional wisdom says you have to choose – soft or durable, speed or rigor, quality or price – we ask why that trade-off has to exist in the first place. Our pace is fast and the bar is high because our customers expect a lot from us and we refuse to let them down. We believe the best results come from challenging ourselves, learning from one another, and building on each other's strengths. Here, responsibility is not determined by role, tenure, or seniority. Every team member - no matter their level - has the opportunity to drive our business and shape our trajectory. If you’re someone who likes to imagine new possibilities and build better systems rather than plug-in to outdated ones, Quince is the place for you. THE ROLE Principal Engineer : Warehouse Engineering We’re looking for a Principal Engineer : Warehouse Engineering to define the technical vision and architecture for Quince’s warehouse technology ecosystem. You will build the platforms that power inventory movement, fulfillment execution, warehouse operations, and returns across a rapidly scaling supply chain network. In this role, you will lead the architecture of Quince’s warehouse integration platform, proprietary Warehouse Management System (WMS), and returns platform. You will solve complex problems across warehouse operations, logistics, inventory, and fulfillment while establishing scalable technical foundations for the future. This role requires a strong combination of distributed systems expertise, operational platform experience, and technical leadership. You will influence architecture across multiple engineering teams, mentor senior engineers, partner with business and operations leaders, and help shape how Quince builds technology for a highly complex and rapidly evolving supply chain. Responsibilities Warehouse Integration Platform Architect and build a standardized integration platform connecting Quince with third-party warehouse operators and WMS platforms. Define integration contracts, APIs, data models, and engineering standards that minimize bespoke development for new warehouse partners. Build scalable mechanisms for monitoring, reconciliation, error handling, and operational visibility across warehouse integrations. Establish platform capabilities that simplify warehouse onboarding and improve reliability across the warehouse network. Warehouse Management System Define the architecture and technical strategy for Quince’s proprietary Warehouse Management System. Build systems supporting inbound, outbound, inventory, fulfillment, and warehouse execution workflows. Design the platform to support both Quince-operated facilities and third-party warehouse operators. Establish scalable multi-tenant architecture, including data isolation, configuration management, access controls, and extensibility. Define architectural patterns that allow the WMS to evolve into a scalable platform for external warehouse operators. Returns & Reverse Logistics Drive the architecture and evolution of Quince’s end-to-end returns platform. Design systems supporting return intake, inventory reconciliation, restocking, refurbishment, replenishment, and disposition. Build operational capabilities that provide visibility into reverse logistics workflows and enable efficient throughput. Ensure returns systems meet high standards for reliability, scalability, observability, and data integrity. AI-Native Engineering Drive the adoption of AI-native engineering practices across warehouse technology. Identify opportunities to apply AI to exception management, warehouse operations, workflow automation, and operational decision-making. Partner with Data Science and Operations Research teams to productionize AI and optimization models within warehouse systems. Establish reliable architecture patterns for integrating AI capabilities into operational workflows while maintaining correctness and reliability. Technical Leadership Define the long-term technical vision, architecture principles, and roadmap for warehouse engineering. Lead architecture reviews and provide technical direction across warehouse, logistics, supply chain, and platform teams. Establish engineering standards around scalability, reliability, observability, data integrity, and operational excellence. Identify architectural risks, technical debt, and systemic opportunities across warehouse technology. Make high-impact technical decisions while balancing immediate business needs with long-term platform scalability. Organizational Impact Mentor senior and staff engineers and raise the technical bar across the engineering organization. Partner closely with warehouse operations, logistics, product, and business stakeholders to translate operational challenges into scalable technical solutions. Influence technical strategy across multiple teams and domains without relying solely on organizational authority. Contribute to hiring, talent development, and building a high-performing engineering organization. Represent warehouse engineering in broader technical and organizational initiatives. Qualifications Required: 12+ years of software engineering experience building large-scale operational, supply chain, logistics, warehouse, or similar systems. Proven experience architecting and scaling distributed systems and event-driven architectures in production. Deep expertise in designing highly reliable systems where data integrity, consistency, and operational correctness are critical. Experience designing integration platforms and replacing bespoke integrations with standardized, scalable frameworks. Strong understanding of multi-tenant architecture, data isolation, API design, configuration management, and platform extensibility. Experience setting technical direction across multiple engineering teams or business domains. Strong understanding of inventory management, fulfillment workflows, and operational system design. Experience balancing scalability, performance, reliability, observability, and operational complexity. Strong technical communication skills with the ability to influence senior engineering and business stakeholders. Demonstrated ability to mentor senior engineers and drive engineering excellence across teams. Experience working with AI-enabled development workflows and/or integrating AI capabilities into production systems. Ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment with significant ambiguity and ownership. Preferred: Direct experience designing or building Warehouse Management Systems (WMS) at scale. Experience working with commercial WMS platforms and understanding the trade-offs between vendor solutions and custom-built systems. Experience with reverse logistics, inventory condition management, refurbishment, and disposition workflows. Experience in e-commerce fulfillment, 3PL operations, retail, logistics, or large-scale warehouse networks. Strong understanding of warehouse automation, inventory accuracy, fulfillment optimization, or operational planning systems. Experience building multi-tenant SaaS platforms serving external customers, operators, or partners. Experience partnering with Data Science or Operations Research teams to productionize optimization and decision-making models. Experience in high-growth, technology-first organizations with highly autonomous engineering teams. WHY QUINCE? Joining Quince means being part of a mission-driven team reshaping retail. You will work alongside talented colleagues, tackle meaningful challenges, and contribute to building a more sustainable, accessible future for customers and partners alike. full_description: Job Description Designs, implements, and optimizes components in distributed systems with an emphasis on scalability, resiliency, and operability. Proactively detects and mitigates issues via tests, alarms, dashboards, and telemetry; authors runbooks and participates in incident response and RCAs. Implements standard replication and synchronization, develops automation/IaC for troubleshooting and maintenance, and applies advanced security controls (encryption, access, remediation) while ensuring change, compliance, and documentation standards are met. System Design & Architecture - System Reliability Design: –Collaborates with team to build fault-tolerant components capable of withstanding in-service updates by implementing redundancy, replication, and automatic failover mechanisms. –Applies recovery oriented computing principles to design components that effectively handle service disruptions. –Implements retry mechanisms, circuit breakers, and timeouts to help handle network unreliability. System Design & Architecture - Correctness / Availability: –Designs and implements functional requirements and testing for assigned features within an existing system. –Implements tests scenarios (e.g., fault-injection, brown-out) to evaluate system correctness. –Implements standard data replication and synchronization techniques to maintain data integrity and availability. Operational Troubleshooting & Incident Management: –Diagnoses, debugs, and resolves issues in system components to support ongoing operation. –Implements basic strategies to prevent interruptions, ensuring no maintenance windows are required for customers and users when resolving issues. –Designs and implements automation scripts and tooling used to troubleshoot operational issues. –Participates in operational support rotations, assisting in incident responses and root cause investigations. Compliance & Security: –Applies advanced security measures to protect data and applications in multi-tenant environments, including encryption and access controls. –Implements remediation plans to continuously improve security. –Collaborates with the team to ensure cloud infrastructure complies with relevant industry standards and regulations and that documentation is up-to-date Automation & Change Management: –Maintains automation scripts and tools (e.g., Infrastructure as Code (IaC)) for managing cloud infrastructure. –Adheres to change management plans for patching, updating, and rolling back applications. Core Responsibilities Planning & Execution: –Track timelines with minimal supervision, ensuring work is completed in a timely manner and is in alignment with project requirements. –Prioritize and adjust work as resources or timelines change, with some guidance Collaboration & Partnership: –Collaborates across teams to align on expectations and achieve shared objectives. Builds and maintains a comprehensive understanding of business, stakeholder, and/or customer needs to build and support effective partnerships. Actively listens to diverse perspectives and asks questions to ensure understanding of others. Problem Solving: –Independently identifies and addresses standard and non-standard issues in accordance with standard practices, escalating more complex issues as appropriate. Analyzes data and/or information from multiple sources to troubleshoot standard and non-standard errors. Contributes to knowledge sharing and best practices Continuous Learning: –Embraces continuous learning by actively seeking to build knowledge and new skills and/or tools, and staying current with industry trends and best practices. Seeks out and leverages feedback and training to improve skills. Contributes to a culture of continuous learning and knowledge sharing with team members.. Continuous Improvement: –Develops ideas and recommends updates to increase the efficiency and effectiveness of processes, protocols, and workflows within a team. Seeks input from team members on alternative approaches and methods for improving work. In Field Service Management, this means building AI-native experiences for scheduling, dispatch, and service workflows that automate routine work, escalate exceptions, and improve customer outcomes.
